blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla said that criminal networks are exploiting advances in technology and growing cross-border connectivity, urging Asean member states to strengthen regional cooperation to counter complex threats no country can tackle alone. Remulla on Tuesday opened the 20th Asean Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime (AMMTC), where he is set to lead discussions on coordinated regional efforts to address major security threats. “Criminal networks are taking advantage of technology, economic integration, and cross-border connectivity.
